lines.line: At the top of the climb, the pipe now carries you on to five puzzle levels.
The first holds a crystal that lets you copy yourself onto any square with a turquoise border.
Every copy moves when you move, so one of you can hold a plate down while the other crosses the bridge it opens.
On the next level, a single jump has to carry both of you over your own gaps.
Orange rings take cuts instead. Cut yourself, click a ring, and you are standing on it.
One level needs three of you at once, so you copy, cut the copy across, and copy again.
The last asks you to throw your head over a wall, and roll it under a barrier.
